title: Warembori language
description: Language of Papua, Indonesia, of uncertain affiliation
extract: Warembori is a moribund language spoken by about 600 people in Warembori village, Mamberamo Hilir District, Mamberamo Raya Regency, located around river mouths on the north coast of Papua, Indonesia.
